name: Attention (non-causal)
description: Scaled dot-product attention without masking: out = softmax(q @ k^T / sqrt(D), dim=-1) @ v. q, k, v and out are float16 [B, H, S, D]; D (head dim) is one of 32, 64, 128. Accumulate in float32. Avoid materializing the full S x S score matrix in global memory if you can.
signature: run(q: Tensor[B, H, S, D], k: Tensor[B, H, S, D], v: Tensor[B, H, S, D]) -> Tensor[B, H, S, D]
provenance: Original KernelRL task (written from scratch). Task category inspired by KernelBench level 3 (github.com/ScalingIntelligence/KernelBench, MIT license); no KernelBench code copied.
